Name: Morning Dew Mod Manager
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[center][b][size=6]🌸Morning Dew🌸[/size][/b]
The friendly mod manager for Stardew Valley
[left][/left]
[left][b][b]Morning Dew[/b] is a small, fast Windows app that makes managing SMAPI mods easy, even if you have never touched a mod folder before. Tick a box to turn a mod on or off, press [b]Play[/b], and see in plain English whether anything is wrong. You can even browse and install mods from Nexus right inside the app. No file editing, no guessing.[/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[b][b][u][size=4]🌸What it does🌸[/size][/u][/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Play button[/b]: starts Stardew Valley through SMAPI with the mods you have turned on. It warns you first if something will stop a mod from loading.[/*]
[*][b]One-click on/off[/b]: tick a mod to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Nothing is deleted. (It simply adds or removes a dot at the start of the mod's folder name, which is how SMAPI skips a mod.)[/*]
[*][b]Status at a glance[/b]: a big card tells you "All good, ready to play" or exactly what needs fixing.[/*]
[*][b]Nexus Mods window[/b]: browse Stardew Valley mods without leaving the app. Every mod is a card with its picture and the start of its description. Look through Top downloads (all time), Trending, New and Just updated, sort by most downloads, most endorsed, newest, recently updated, name or author, search, and hide mods you already have. There is a tab with the author's own mods too.[/*]
[*][b]Install from Nexus[/b]: Premium members install in one click. Free members press [b]Download[/b]; Morning Dew opens Nexus' own download page, and after its short countdown (about 5 seconds) Nexus hands the file to Morning Dew, which downloads and installs it. Mods you already have are marked "Installed".[/*]
[*][b]Drag and drop installs[/b]: drop a mod's .zip onto the window and Morning Dew shows what it will install first. Updates keep the mod's settings and set the old copy aside.[/*]
[*][b]Mod sets[/b]: save which mods are on and switch between sets, for example "Vanilla+" and "Co-op". Picking a set switches to it straight away and refreshes the list. Tick [b]Also update these mods[/b] and Morning Dew also looks for newer versions of that set's mods on Nexus.[/*]
[*][b]Conflict finder[/b]: finds duplicate mods (SMAPI loads none of the copies), missing or turned-off requirements, mods SMAPI will skip, and Content Patcher packs that change the same thing. Each problem comes with plain advice and a one-click action where possible.[/*]
[*][b]Clickable folders[/b]: every duplicate or problem shows its folder as a link that opens File Explorer right on it.[/*]
[*][b]Game log reader[/b]: reads SMAPI's last log and explains it: which mods were skipped and why, what each error means, and what to do. Repeated errors are grouped, and there is a Copy summary button for asking for help.[/*]
[*][b]Update list[/b]: a sortable table of every mod with installed version, latest version and status. Works straight away from SMAPI's own report in your last log; an optional "Check online" button (only runs when you press it) refreshes it from smapi.io, and with your own Nexus key also looks at Nexus pages.[/*]
[*][b]Tidy up[/b]: finds duplicate mods, leftover zip files and empty folders. Removed items are moved aside and can be put back.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click a mod[/b]: turn on/off, open its folder, open its Nexus page, or delete it. Deleting sends the whole mod folder to the Windows Recycle Bin so you can restore it.[/*]
[*][b]Click a mod to learn about it[/b]: what it does, what it needs, and which other mods need it.[/*]
[*][b]Filters and search[/b]: All, On, Off, or Needs attention, plus search by name or author. Click a column to sort.[/*]
[*][b]28 THEMES[/b]: The animated ones are gentle and switch off by themselves if Windows animations are off. [/*]
[*][b]Languages[/b]: English, Español, Français, Deutsch and Português (Brasil),  简体中文, 繁體中文, Русский, 한국어, 日本語, Türkçe and Italiano . The translations were made with AI, so a few phrases may sound off. You can fix them or add your own language with a simple .json file.[/*]
[*][b]Small comforts[/b]: a short first-run tour, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+F search, F5 refresh, Space on/off, Delete remove), an Open Mods folder button, and it remembers your window size and sort order.[/*]
[/list][left][/left]
[b][b][size=4][u]🌸Requirements🌸[/u][/size][/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley with [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] installed[/*]
[*]Nothing else to install. The app is a single exe.[/*]
[*]For the Nexus Mods window: your own free Nexus API key (copy it from your Nexus account under Site preferences, API Keys and paste it into Morning Dew once).[/*]
[/list]
[b][b][u][size=4]🌸Installation🌸[/size][/u][/b][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the file and extract it anywhere you like (your Desktop is fine).[/*]
[*]Run [b]MorningDew.exe[/b]. It finds your Stardew Valley Mods folder automatically. If it can't, it asks you to pick the "Mods" folder once.[/*]
[*]Close the game before turning mods on or off.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Windows may show a "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) message[/b] because the app is new and not code-signed. Choose [b]More info[/b], then [b]Run anyway[/b].[/b][/left]

[b][b][u][size=4]🌸Good to know🌸[/size][/u][/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Morning Dew changes mod folders only in the ways described above. It does not edit mods' files, and it does not add or change anything inside the game itself.[/*]
[*]Nothing is sent over the internet unless you press a button for it. "Check online" sends your enabled mods' IDs and versions to smapi.io (and to Nexus Mods if you add your own key). The Nexus Mods window, installs from Nexus and "Also update these mods" talk to nexusmods.com with your key: Nexus sees your key, what you ask for, and the IDs of mods you install or check. Mod pictures are loaded from Nexus' own picture servers without your key. Your folders, files and Windows name are never sent.[/*]
[*]Your Nexus key is stored encrypted for your Windows account and is never put in logs.[/*]
[*]Nexus only gives free members a download after the countdown on its own page, so Morning Dew follows that same path instead of working around it. It can optionally make Nexus' "Mod Manager Download" button open Morning Dew; you can switch that off again in the Nexus Mods window, and Vortex or Mod Organizer take it back when they start.[/*]
[*]The conflict finder reads Content Patcher files without evaluating every condition, so overlaps are heads-ups to review, not proof that something is broken.[/*]
[*]Morning Dew does not re-order your mods. SMAPI loads them in the right order by itself.[/*]
[*]Settings, mod sets and theme are stored in %APPDATA%\MorningDew.[/*]
[/list][left][/left]
[b][b][u][size=4]🌸Uninstalling🌸[/size][/u][/b][/b]
[left]Delete MorningDew.exe (and, if you want, the %APPDATA%\MorningDew folder). Your mods are untouched. If you left any mod turned off, remove the dot at the start of its folder name or turn it on in Morning Dew first. If you turned on Nexus' "Mod Manager Download" link for Morning Dew, switch it off in the Nexus Mods window first.[/left]
[left][/left]
[b][b][u][size=4]🌸Feedback🌸[/size][/u][/b][/b]
[left]Found a bug or want a feature? Leave a comment or post a bug report. If something looks wrong, the Game log button's "Copy summary" text, or the "Copy diagnostics" button, helps a lot.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][i]Morning Dew is an unofficial fan-made tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe, Chucklefish, the SMAPI team or Nexus Mods.[/i]
[center][/center]
